## Prepare variable combinations for scenario exploration
Include influenza activity, influenza vaccination coverage, temperature, and absolute humidity for scenario exploration.
```{r chunk10_01_Scenario_exploration_virus_pairs}
data_obs.null <- data_country_obs_null[, c("year_decimal",virus_name,"INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine","Temp", "AH")]

all_vars_other <- c(virus_name)
all_vars_flu <- c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL")
var_pairs0 <- expand.grid(all_vars_other, all_vars_flu)
var_pairs0$Var3 <- "Vaccine, Temp, AH"
var_pairs0$mul_drivers <- paste0(var_pairs0[,1],", ",var_pairs0[,2],", ",var_pairs0[,3])
colnames(var_pairs0) <- c("target","flu","vero","mul_drivers")
print(var_pairs0$mul_drivers)
rownames(var_pairs0) <- var_pairs0$mul_drivers
all_vars4 <- unique(var_pairs0$mul_drivers)
print(all_vars4)
```

### Prepare lagged variables for scenario exploration
```{r chunk10_02_Scenario_exploration_prepare}
# Load observed multiview EDM results
out_path0 <- "02_output/02_CCM/03_mul_CCM/01_mul_CCM_country_result"
text <- read.csv(paste(out_path0,"/", country_index, "_mul_ccm_obs_result_",
                                 country_name,".csv", sep=""))
data_obs.lag_best_com <- list()

for(var_id in 1:length(all_vars4)){
  var=all_vars4[var_id]
# Extract selected embedding variables and lags
selected_rows <- text[text$var_col == var&text$country == country_name, ]
numbers_list <- list()
for (col_name in colnames(selected_rows[grep("^name_", colnames(selected_rows))])) {
  column_values <- selected_rows[[col_name]]
  numbers <- as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", column_values))
  number_name <- sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", column_values[1])  # Extract the variable name from the first element
  numbers_list[[number_name]] <- numbers
  }
best_lag <- unlist(numbers_list)
best_lag_df <- data.frame(variable = names(best_lag), lag = best_lag)
var_name <- strsplit(var, ", ")[[1]]

# Construct lagged data for scenario exploration
data_obs.lag_best <- lapply(var_name, function(col_name) {
  shift(data_obs.null[[col_name]], n = best_lag[col_name], fill = NA)
})

lag_drivers <- c(paste0(var_name[1],"_lag1"),var_name[2:5])
names(data_obs.lag_best) <- lag_drivers 

data_obs.lag_best <- cbind(data_obs.null[,c("year_decimal",var_name[1])], data.frame(data_obs.lag_best))
colnames(data_obs.lag_best)[colnames(data_obs.lag_best) == "data_obs.null[, var_name[1]]"] <- var_name[1]
data_obs.lag_best$time_index <- 1:nrow(data_obs.lag_best)
data_obs.lag_best <- data_obs.lag_best[, c("time_index",  names(data_obs.lag_best)[1:(ncol(data_obs.lag_best)-1)])]

data_obs.lag_best$mul_drivers <- NULL
data_obs.lag_best$mul_drivers <- paste0(var_name[1],("_lag1")," ", var_name[2]," ",var_name[3]," ",var_name[4], " ", var_name[5])
data_obs.lag_best_com[[var]] <- data_obs.lag_best
}
```


### Scenario Exploration: Influenza Activity
```{r chunk10_03_Scenario_exploration_for_flu}
se.flu_summary <- list()
for(var_id in 1:length(all_vars4)){
var=all_vars4[var_id]
data_obs.lag_best <- data_obs.lag_best_com[[var]]
mul_drivers <- unique(data_obs.lag_best$mul_drivers)

split_drivers <- unlist(strsplit(mul_drivers, " "))
vars_num <- length(unique(split_drivers))
flu_var <- as.character(split_drivers[[2]])
virus_var <- gsub("_lag1$", "", as.character(split_drivers[[1]]))

lib_num <- c(1,NROW(data_country.norm))
pred_num <- lib_num +NROW(data_country.norm)
# Define the perturbation in influenza activity
delta <- 2/ sd(data_country[[flu_var]],na.rm=TRUE)
# Construct increased and decreased influenza activity scenarios
data_obs.plus <- data_obs.lag_best
data_obs.plus[[flu_var]] <- data_obs.plus[[flu_var]] +delta/2
data_obs.plus <- bind_rows(data_obs.lag_best,data_obs.plus)%>%
  select(-mul_drivers)

data_obs.minus <- data_obs.lag_best
data_obs.minus[[flu_var]] <-data_obs.minus[[flu_var]] - delta/2
data_obs.minus <- bind_rows(data_obs.lag_best,data_obs.minus)%>%
  select(-mul_drivers)

se.flu <- data.frame()
  Mview.plus <- block_lnlp(data_obs.plus, lib = lib_num, pred = pred_num, 
                            norm = 2, method = c("simplex"), tp = 1, 
                            num_neighbors = "e+1", columns =  mul_drivers, target_column = virus_var,
                            stats_only = F, first_column_time =  TRUE, exclusion_radius = NULL, 
                            epsilon = NULL, theta = NULL, silent = TRUE, save_smap_coefficients = FALSE)
  Mview.minus <- block_lnlp(data_obs.minus, lib = lib_num, pred = pred_num, 
                            norm = 2, method = c("simplex"), tp = 1, 
                            num_neighbors = "e+1", columns =  mul_drivers, target_column = virus_var,
                            stats_only = F, first_column_time =  TRUE, exclusion_radius = NULL, 
                            epsilon = NULL, theta = NULL, silent = TRUE, save_smap_coefficients = FALSE)
  Mul_prediction.plus <- Mview.plus[["model_output"]] %>%
  rename(pred.plus = Predictions)
  
  Mul_prediction.minus <- Mview.minus[["model_output"]] %>%
  rename(pred.minus = Predictions)
  
  results.flu <- full_join(Mul_prediction.plus,
                       Mul_prediction.minus,
                       by = c("time_index", "Observations")) %>%
  mutate(delta =((pred.plus-pred.minus)/2) *sd(data_country[[virus_var]][-nrow(data_country)],na.rm=TRUE))
  
  year_decimal_data <- data_obs.lag_best %>%
  select(time_index, year_decimal)
  
  results.flu <-   results.flu%>%
  left_join(year_decimal_data, by = "time_index") 
  
  results.flu$country <- country_name
  se.flu <- results.flu %>% select(time_index,year_decimal, Observations, pred.plus, pred.minus, delta, country)
  se.flu$mul_type <- var
  se.flu_summary[[var]] <- se.flu

}

se.flu_com <- bind_rows(se.flu_summary)
# Export country-specific scenario exploration results
out_path1 <- "02_output/02_CCM/03_mul_CCM/02_mul_smap_country_result"
dir.create(out_path1)
write.csv(se.flu_com,paste(out_path1,"/", country_index, "_mul_smap_flu_result_",
                                 country_name,".csv", sep=""),row.names = F)
```
